headline: Mexico's Economic Activity Likely Grew 0.2% Monthly in October: IOAE
summary: Mexico's IOAE indicator projects economic activity grew 0.2% month on month in October. On an annual basis, growth is projected at 2.3%, slower than the 3.1% projected for September.
why: The IOAE is a timely monthly estimate of Mexico's economic activity. It helps investors gauge the pace of growth in Latin America's second-largest economy.
original_headline: Actividad económica de México habría crecido 0.2% mensual durante octubre: IOAE
